title: Convexity conjecture for the Bernstein basis square-sum
statement:
Let $B_n$ be the Bernstein operator with basis polynomials $b_{nk}(x)=\binom{n}{k}x^k(1-x)^{n-k}$, and define

$$
\varphi_n(x):=\sum_{k=0}^{n}b_{nk}^2(x),\qquad x\in[0,1].
$$

**Convexity conjecture.** The function $\varphi_n$ is convex on $[0,1]$. This conjecture concerns the shape of the sum of squares of the Bernstein basis and would sharpen the understanding of the coefficient appearing in the Chebyshev–Grüss-type inequality for the Bernstein operator; no resolution is supplied in the source.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1401.7908

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of January 2014).
source_name: Heiner Gonska, Ioan Raşa and Maria-Daniela Rusu, “Chebyshev-Grüss-type inequalities via discrete oscillations”, arXiv:1401.7908 (2014).
